description: The Karnataka Udyogini Scheme is a self-employment support initiative that provides women in Karnataka with collateral-free business loans and subsidies to start their own enterprises.
objective: To encourage women to start their own enterprises by providing subsidies on loans at reasonable interest rates, preventing them from borrowing from local money lenders.
benefits: Collateral-free business loan up to Rs. 3,00,000 at a reasonable interest rate; 50% loan subsidy for SC/ST beneficiaries and 30% loan subsidy for General/Special category beneficiaries; 3 to 6 days of EDP training.
eligibility: Women permanent residents of Karnataka aged 18 to 55 years; business unit cost between Rs. 1,00,000 and Rs. 3,00,000; annual income limit less than Rs. 2,00,000 for SC/ST and less than Rs. 1,50,000 for General/Special category (no income cap for widows or disabled women).
documents_required: Applicant's Aadhar Card, Birth Certificate, Address and Income Proof, BPL Card & Ration Card (for BPL), Caste Certificate (if applicable), Bank Account Details, Mobile Number, Three Passport Size Photographs, Training or Experience certificate, Detailed Project Report, Equipment/machinery/expenses quotations, Any Other Document Required by the Bank/NBFC
application_process: Obtain the application form free of cost from the District Office of Karnataka State Women's Development Corporation, fill it out, attach required documents, and submit it back to the same district office. Following verification and 3 to 6 days of EDP training, loan amounts are transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account.
implementing_agency: Karnataka State Women's Development Corporation

description: The Karnataka Thayi Bhagya Scheme is a government welfare initiative launched in 2009 for pregnant and lactating women in the state. It provides free, cashless healthcare services during pre and post-pregnancy periods in government and empaneled private hospitals.
objective: To provide free of cost basic treatment and healthcare to poor and needy pregnant women during their pregnancy.
benefits: Free of cost delivery (normal, cesarean, complicated, forceps) in empaneled private or government hospitals, free cashless pre- and post-pregnancy treatment, free transportation, and free checkups and medicines. Benefits apply to the first two deliveries.
eligibility: Pregnant women or lactating mothers who are residents of Karnataka and belong to the BPL, Scheduled Caste (SC), or Scheduled Tribe (ST) categories.
documents_required: Residence Proof of Karnataka, BPL Card or Ration Card, Caste Certificate, Aadhar Card, ANC Registration Number, Mobile Number
application_process: Contact the local ASHA Worker or Junior Female Health Officer, who will fill out the application form on behalf of the beneficiary, register her, and issue an ANC Card to present at hospitals.
implementing_agency: Department of Women and Child Development, Karnataka

description: The Karnataka Madilu Kit Scheme is a welfare initiative launched in 2007 by the Government of Karnataka for pregnant women. Under the scheme, mothers receive a post-natal wellness kit containing 19 daily-use items or financial assistance following hospital delivery.
objective: To promote deliveries in hospitals so that the mother and child can be treated better.
benefits: A Madilu Kit consisting of 19 daily use items (approximate cost Rs. 1,500) for government hospital deliveries, or Rs. 1,000 for deliveries in private hospitals.
eligibility: Pregnant women who are residents of Karnataka belonging to BPL or SC/ST categories, delivering their child in a government (PHC, CHC, Taluk, District, Medical College) or private hospital. The benefit is limited to 2 hospital deliveries.
documents_required: Residence Proof of Karnataka, BPL Card or Ration Card, Caste Certificate, Aadhar Card, ANC Registration Number, Mobile Number
application_process: No separate application is required. Pregnant women can contact their area's ASHA worker to get enrolled, and the kit is provided automatically after delivery in a government hospital.
implementing_agency: Department of Women and Child Development, Karnataka

Government of Karnataka will provide financial assistance of Rs. 2,000/- (including the amount of Janani Suraksha Yojana ) to BPL Category Lactating Mother to take care her post natal expenses. For the SC and ST Women, the financial assistance is Rs. 3,000/- in Prasoothi Araike Scheme. This financial assistance also include the financial assistance provided under Janani Suraksha Yojana.
benefits: Benefits received by women beneficiary under Karnataka Prasoothi Araike Scheme is mentioned below :- Financial Assistance of Rs. 3,000/- to SC and ST Lactating Mother. Financial Assistance of Rs. 2,000/- to BPL Category Lactating Mother. eligibility: Eligibility Women Beneficiary should be a Resident of Karnataka. Following Women are eligible under Prasoothi Araike Scheme :- Pregnant Women. Women belongs to BPL Category. Women belongs to Schedule Caste/ Tribe Category. Women who delivers her child in Government Hospital.
documents_required: Document Required The below mentioned documents is required at the time of enrolling in Prasoothi Araike Scheme of Government of Karnataka :- Residence Proof of Karnataka. description: Karnataka Thayi Bhagya Plus Scheme is a welfare scheme launched in 2010 by the Government of Karnataka to support pregnant women. It targets eligible pregnant women who deliver their child in a non-empanelled private hospital.
objective: To provide financial assistance to women to cover their delivery expenses.
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 1,000 for delivering a child in a non-empanelled private hospital.
eligibility: Pregnant women who are residents of Karnataka, belong to BPL, Schedule Caste (SC), or Schedule Tribe (ST) categories, and deliver their child in a non-empanelled private hospital.
documents_required: Residence Proof of Karnataka, BPL Card or Ration Card, Caste Certificate, Aadhar Card, ANC Registration Number, Mobile Number, Bank Details
application_process: Eligible beneficiaries can apply by submitting delivery records from the private hospital to their local ASHA Worker or Junior Female Health Officer, who will register them and forward the application for approval and direct bank transfer.
implementing_agency: Department of Women and Child Development, Karnataka

scheme_name: Karnataka Samagra Mathru Arogya Palana Scheme
description: The Karnataka Samagra Mathru Arogya Palana Scheme is a comprehensive welfare program by the Government of Karnataka for pregnant women and lactating mothers. It operates through four sub-schemes—Thayi Bhagya Scheme, Thayi Bhagya Plus Scheme, Prasoothi Araike Scheme, and Madilu Kit Scheme—to offer medical treatment, essential supplies, and financial assistance.
objective: To provide free delivery services and financial support for pre and post-delivery expenses, create a safe environment for mothers and newborns, and decrease the infant mortality rate in Karnataka.
benefits: Free delivery in government or private hospitals; cashless pre- and post-pregnancy treatment; free transportation, checkups, and medicines; financial assistance of Rs. 3,000 for SC/ST lactating mothers, Rs. 2,000 for BPL category lactating mothers, and Rs. 1,000 for delivering in non-empanelled private hospitals; Madilu Kit containing 19 daily use items worth around Rs. 1,500.
eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers who are residents of Karnataka, including women belonging to BPL, Schedule Caste (SC), or Schedule Tribe (ST) categories, or women delivering in non-empanelled private hospitals.
documents_required: Residence Proof of Karnataka, BPL Card or Ration Card, Caste Certificate, Aadhar Card, ANC Registration Number, Mobile Number, Bank Details
application_process: There is no separate application required. Beneficiaries can contact their area's ASHA Worker or Junior Female Health Officer, who will register them separately under each scheme and forward the application for approval.
implementing_agency: Department of Health and Family Welfare, Karnataka

description: Karnataka Krushi Aranya Protsaha Yojane Submitted by Shahrukh on
objective: The main objective behind launching this scheme is to encourage the farmers to plant trees and increase the forest cover. All the farmers of Karnataka State are eligible to take part in Karnataka Krushi Aranya Protsaha Yojane. This scheme is also known by some other names such as "Krushi Aranya Protsaha Yojana" or "Krushi Aranya Protsaha Scheme" . This scheme plays an income enhancing role for the farmers as it provides financial assistance just to plant and nurture the tree saddling for only 3 years.
benefits: Benefits Financial Assistance to Plant Tree Seedlings. Beneficiary Farmers of Karnataka.
eligibility: Eligibility Only those Farmers are eligible to plant tree seedlings who fulfils the below mentioned eligibility condition of Krushi Aranya Protsaha Yojane :- Farmers of Karnataka. Farmers who Owns a Land.
documents_required: Document Required Documents that are required at the time of applying for Karnataka Krushi Aranya Protsaha Yojane are as follows :- Residence Proof. Caste Certificate. (If Applicable). Aadhar Card. Passport Size Photograph. Details of Tree Seedlings. Bank Account Details. Land Details/ Pahani of Land. Ineligible Tree Seedlings The following tree species are not eligible for plantation and payment under Krushi Aranya Protsaha Yojane :- Eucalyptus. Acacia. Silver Oak. Casuarina.
application_process: How to Apply To apply for Karnataka Krushi Aranya Protsaha Yojane, farmer has to visit his nearest forest range office. Collect an Application Form of Krushi Aranya Protsaha Yojane from that Office free of cost. Fill it properly and attached the required documents with it. Submit it to the same forest range office along with the registration fees of Rs. 10/-. Forest Officials will scrutinised the Krushi Aranya Protsaha Yojane Application Form and Documents thoroughly. Then the tree seedlings will be distributed by forest officials among the selected farmers.
implementing_agency: Nodal Department Karnataka Forest Department. Subscription Mode of Apply Through Krushi Aranya Protsaha Yojane Application Form. description: The Karnataka Ganga Kalyana Scheme is an irrigation assistance program implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation. It provides 100% financial assistance to small and marginal minority farmers in Karnataka for borewell construction, pump set installation, and electrification.
objective: To improve irrigation facilities on dry agricultural land for eligible minority farmers, reduce their dependence on rainfall, and enhance crop production and agricultural income.
benefits: 100% financial assistance (subsidy) covering borewell drilling, pump set installation, and electrification up to ₹4 lakh for individual projects in Bengaluru Rural, Kolar, Chikkaballapur, Ramanagara, and Tumakuru districts, and up to ₹3 lakh in all other districts.
eligibility: Must be a permanent resident of Karnataka aged 18 or above belonging to a notified minority community (Muslims, Jains, Christians, Sikhs, Parsis, Buddhists). Must be a small, marginal, or very small tenant farmer owning between 1 acre 20 guntas and 5 acres of dry land (minimum 1 acre in Kodagu, Dakshina Kannada, Udupi, Uttara Kannada, Chikkamagaluru, Shivamogga, and Hassan districts). Annual family income must not exceed ₹6 lakh.
documents_required: Minority Community Certificate, Income Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Latest RTC copy of agricultural land, Small Farmer / Marginal Farmer / Very Small Tenant Farmer Certificate, Copy of Bank Passbook, Latest Land Revenue Paid Receipt, Self-Declaration Form signed by applicant, Self-Declaration Form from Surety/Guarantor
application_process: Applicants can apply online via the Karnataka Online Application Management System (OAMS) portal or offline by submitting a filled application form at the KMDC District Office. Authorities verify documents and perform a field inspection of the land prior to beneficiary selection.
implementing_agency: Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation Limited (KMDC)

description: The Karnataka Bhagyalakshmi Scheme is a financial assistance program launched in 2006 for up to two girl children in Below Poverty Line (BPL) families in Karnataka. The government deposits money with LIC at the child's birth, which pays out a maturity lump sum when the girl attains 18 years of age.
objective: To change societal attitudes towards the birth of girl children, promote their education, prevent female foeticide, and protect girls from child labour and early marriage.
benefits: Rs. 19,300 deposit at birth yielding Rs. 1,00,097 maturity amount at age 18 for the first girl child; Rs. 18,350 deposit yielding Rs. 1,00,052 maturity amount for the second girl child; financial assistance ranging from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 75,000 in case of disability or death of insured parents.
eligibility: Applicants must be domiciled residents of Karnataka from BPL families; max two girl children born after March 31, 2006 per family; child must be registered within one year of birth, not involved in child labor, unmarried before age 18, and have passed at least 8th grade to claim maturity.
documents_required: Birth Certificate of Child, BPL Card, Income Certificate, Parents Address Proof, Joint Photograph of Parents and Child, Marriage Certificate or Self Declaration, Bank Account Details of the girl child, Family Planning Certificate (if availing for 2nd child)
application_process: Obtain the application form for free from an Anganwadi Center or Gram Panchayat Office, fill it out, attach the required documents, and submit it back to the same office for verification.
implementing_agency: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka

description: The Karnataka Shrama Shakthi Loan Scheme is a financial welfare initiative by the Government of Karnataka for minority traditional artisans. It provides collateral-free loans along with back-end subsidy benefits and skill training to help beneficiaries start or expand their business.
objective: To support minority traditional artisans financially and help them improve their skills to start or expand their trade.
benefits: Collateral-free loan of Rs. 50,000 at 4% annual interest rate; 50% back-end subsidy if 50% of the loan is repaid within 36 months; skill training for eligible applicants.
eligibility: Must be a permanent resident of Karnataka aged 18 to 55 years belonging to a religious minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Parsi, Jain, Christian, Buddhist) with an annual family income under Rs 3.50 lakh. Government employees and those who availed corporation loan/subsidy in the last 5 years (except Arivu Loan Scheme) are ineligible.
documents_required: Online Application Form, Residence Proof of Karnataka, Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Business Project Report, Two Latest Passport Size Photo, Bank Account Details, Self Declaration Form, Surety Self Declaration Form
application_process: Apply online via the Karnataka Online Application Management System Portal by registering with a mobile OTP, filling details, and uploading documents. Print the submitted online application, attach required documents, and submit the hard copy to the District Selection Panel for scrutiny.
implementing_agency: Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation Limited

description: The Karnataka Prabhuddha Overseas Scholarship Scheme is an educational welfare initiative by the Government of Karnataka for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students. It provides comprehensive financial support to pursue undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral studies in top foreign universities.
objective: To assist students to pursue their higher education from foreign universities.
benefits: Full tuition fees, medical insurance, full VISA fees, and free air passage; maintenance allowance of Rs. 8,00,000 per year (or 75% of actual amount); Rs. 1,00,000 per year for books and miscellaneous allowances. Financial assistance is 100% for annual family income up to Rs. 8 Lakhs, 50% for income between Rs. 8 to 15 Lakhs, and 33% for income above Rs. 15 Lakhs.
eligibility: Must be a resident of Karnataka belonging to the SC or ST category. Admission required in Top 325 World Ranking Universities with cleared GRE/GMAT/TOEFL/IELTS exam. Age limit: max 21 years for Undergraduate courses (minimum 80% marks in previous exam); max 35 years for Post Graduate and Doctoral courses (minimum 55% marks in previous exam).
documents_required: Aadhar Card, PAN Card, Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Education Related Documents, Latest 2 Year Income Tax Return, Foreign University Offer Letter, Passport, Fees Details, Scorecard of GRE/GMAT/TOEFL/IELTS Exam
application_process: Apply online through the Karnataka Pre Examination Training Centre Website or Social Welfare Department portal. Enter Aadhar details, fill in the step-by-step application form, upload required documents, and submit. The application will be forwarded to the District Social Welfare Officer for verification.
implementing_agency: Department of Social Welfare, Karnataka Government

scheme_name: Karnataka Schedule Caste Marriage Assistance Scheme
description: The Karnataka Schedule Caste Marriage Assistance Scheme provides financial incentives to couples belonging to the Scheduled Caste category in Karnataka who opt for a simple marriage. The incentive amount is directly credited to the beneficiary's bank account.
objective: To encourage simple marriage practice among the SC community, which reduces the extra financial burden on families.
benefits: Financial incentive of Rs. 50,000/- directly credited into the beneficiary's bank account.
eligibility: Both bride and groom must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category and be domiciled residents of Karnataka. The annual family income must not exceed Rs. 2 Lakh, and the application must be submitted within one year of a marriage solemnized on or after August 11, 2015.
documents_required: Domicile of Karnataka, Aadhaar Card of Bride and Groom, Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Bank Account Details, Marriage Photograph, Marriage Certificate, Mobile Number
application_process: Applicants must register online on the Department of Social Welfare Portal using their Aadhaar number, fill in basic details regarding the couple and marriage, upload required documents, provide bank details, and submit the application online for verification by the District Social Welfare Officer.
implementing_agency: Commissionerate of Social Welfare, Karnataka Government

scheme_name: Karnataka SC Inter Caste Couple Marriage Assistance Scheme
description: The Karnataka SC Inter Caste Couple Marriage Assistance Scheme provides financial support to Scheduled Caste residents of Karnataka who marry a non-SC Hindu person. Launched in 2015, it aims to eliminate caste-based discrimination in society by encouraging inter-caste marriages.
objective: To eradicate casteism from society and bring every person in Karnataka at par with each other without any caste-based discrimination.
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 2,50,000 for an SC man marrying a woman of another caste, and Rs. 3,00,000 for an SC woman marrying a man of another caste.
eligibility: Both bride and groom must be permanent residents of Karnataka; either the bride or groom must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category and marry a non-SC Hindu person; annual family income must be under Rs. 5,00,000; marriage must have taken place after 01-04-2018; application must be submitted within 1 year of marriage.
documents_required: Domicile of Karnataka, Aadhar Card of Bride and Bride Groom, Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Bank Account Details, Marriage Photograph, Marriage Certificate, Mobile Number
application_process: Apply online on the Department of Social Welfare portal by registering with the Aadhaar numbers of both partners. Complete the application form with personal, marriage, and bank details, upload required documents, preview, and submit. The application is verified by the District Social Welfare Officer before funds are transferred.
implementing_agency: Commissionerate of Social Welfare, Karnataka Government

scheme_name: Karnataka SC Widow Re-Marriage Assistance Scheme
description: The Karnataka SC Widow Re-Marriage Assistance Scheme is a welfare scheme by the Government of Karnataka that provides financial assistance to re-married widows belonging to the Scheduled Caste category.
objective: To support the resettlement of widows from the Scheduled Caste category whose lives have been shattered after their husband's death.
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 3,00,000, or Rs. 2,50,000 for beneficiaries who already received assistance under the simple marriage scheme.
eligibility: Applicant must be a re-married widow belonging to the Scheduled Caste category and a permanent resident of Karnataka (along with her spouse). There is no annual income limit, but the application must be submitted within 1 year of re-marriage. The spouse can belong to any caste or religion.
documents_required: Domicile of Karnataka, Aadhaar Card of Bride and Bridegroom, Caste Certificate, Bank Account Details, Marriage Photograph, Marriage Certificate, Identity Proof of Deceased Husband, Death Certificate of Deceased Husband, Mobile Number
application_process: Apply online via the Social Welfare Department Website by registering with Aadhaar numbers of both spouses. Fill in personal, contact, marriage, and bank details, upload mandatory documents, submit the form, and print the acknowledgement receipt. The application and documents will be verified by the District Social Welfare Officer before funds are disbursed.
implementing_agency: Commissionerate of Social Welfare, Karnataka Government

scheme_name: Karnataka SC Intra Caste Marriage Assistance Scheme
description: The Karnataka SC Intra Caste Marriage Assistance Scheme is a social welfare initiative by the Government of Karnataka that provides financial support to married couples from the Scheduled Caste category who belong to different sub-castes.
objective: To eliminate casteism from society.
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 2,00,000/- (Rs. 1.50 Lakh for couples who availed simple marriage assistance).
eligibility: Bride and Groom must be permanent residents of Karnataka belonging to the Scheduled Caste category but sharing different sub-castes. Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 2,00,000/-, marriage must have taken place on or after 01-04-2018, and applications must be submitted within 1 year of marriage.
documents_required: Domicile of Karnataka, Aadhar Card of Bride and Groom, Caste Certificate, Bank Account Details, Marriage Photograph, Marriage Certificate, Mobile Number
application_process: Apply online on the Social Welfare Department Website by registering with Aadhaar numbers of both spouses, filling in personal, contact, marriage, and bank details, uploading documents, submitting the form, and taking a printout of the Acknowledgement Receipt.
implementing_agency: Commissionerate of Social Welfare, Karnataka Government
